reviews.text: Happy  service

I was in the Pet Stop Blanchardstown and gentleman customer overheard me speaking about my dog not eating well so he recommended to add the Wild natural food brand into the dogs food. It's a game changer. It definitely 5 star natural food and he cant get enough of it.

I visited the store between 12-1pm today and the two female staff members who helped me were absolutely amazing! I had a nervous rescue dog with me and they showed such patience and kindness. They helped me try different sizes of an item for my dog and even gave her a treats, I am so greatful they made what could’ve been a really stressful time so easy!

“I cannot recommend Pet Stop at West End Retail Park in Blanchardstown enough. The staff are always so welcoming and professional, but I especially want to recognize Declan, who went above and beyond to help me. He was patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about finding the right answers for me. It’s rare to see customer service like this now a days. The store is always clean and well stocked, but it’s people like Declan that make it a place worth returning to. Thank you, Declan, for your kindness and professionalism. You absolutely deserve recognition.”

I have been a customer for around three years and never had issues before, which makes this situation even more disappointing. My order was marked as delivered by your delivery partner, but it was delivered to the wrong location and I never received it. I contacted customer service multiple times and received no response. As a loyal customer, I expected better communication and support. I hope this issue can be resolved urgently.
Very helpful staff

They have a wide range of food, especially online, offering brands that other pet shops don’t provide. I mostly order online and love the subscription option and how reliable they are. Also great choice for your courier! The blanch shop is great too, nice staff and sometimes you find a cat sleeping in the shop.
We spend earlier about 300€ for fish and we have been trying to buy more.. We went there 4 times with no luck, there was nobody there to serve us.
The manager was so helpful when me and my mam were buying food for our new puppy, she was so knowledgeable and friendly!!
The employee's always take the time to help and guide you with any questions you have. They create great a atmosphere 👌 👏 …
Just bought aircraft suitable cage - super service and the young man who served me insisted on carrying the cage all the way to my car brendan Madden
i spent 160€ on a fish tank, the guy i was asking for recommendations couldn’t care less, I had to carry the tank down the stairs didn’t even offer help or anything…
Nice girl helped me to find a cat food. Great service.
My favorite shop for cat food also the best fish selection in Ireland

Very knowledgeable staff! Spoke a lot with a girl in the aquatic section tonight and she was fantastic!! Was on the ball with everything and so happy to help.
Will definitely be back and hope to see her again! 😊 …
Great selection of dog treats and toys

Getting a cat (first time cat mom) tomorrow and I came to petstop with some knowledge of what I was doing but their staff, Aaron especially was extremely helpful and patient and knowledgeable with ever query I had. Wide range of products available at reasonable prices. Will definitely be returning here!
Staff very friendly & very knowledgeable  with their products
Good service and products. Considered my local pet shop
Very nice and helpful staff plus their fluffy cat chilling there. Love it. Large enough store that has all the basics for your pet and much more for sure.
Gooood shop, Pretty cool for the aquarium hobby (Blanchardstown)

The aroma of the food always gets my cat running to his bowl. He seems to lick it up in a matter of seconds, making sure not a drop is wasted. It's a good thing this wet food provides all the necessary nutrients. I like knowing that I am providing him with the best, making him happy and healthy. As an owner, I appreciate the convenience and quality.

Very disappointing experience here today. I went into buy a fish and was told the guy was on lunch until half 3 (it was 2.40). We came back at 3.30 and there was no sign. As we waited we looked at the goldfish and black oranda fish. To my horror, there were several dead smaller fish in the tank and a dead black oranda that had definitely been left for over a week. Totally put me off and so sad for the other fish in the tank also.
They have plenty of fish a lot of salt water fish little expensive like all petstop stores

Really great shop. Wide range of small animal goods, plenty of cat and dog toys and foods. For me the most important thing about it is the aquatics section upstairs. All tanks appear clean and pest free and the animals don't appear stressed - very important!
I've dealt with the manager, Damien, who's 100% professional. He gave me plenty of advice and upon long discussion we agreed on the stock list for my marine tank. Some of the fish I chose aren't common and he sourced them for me very quickly. I had to deal with a few hiccups while setting up the tank and Damien held all 14 fish for me for over a month without any extra charge. All fish were healthy and they were waiting for me packed and ready to go - which is important as I visit the store with my toddler who is not patient.
There is a very good selection of dry goods for marine and freshwater aquariums and also a good choice of corals - some uncommon and hard to come by in Ireland.
I could not recommend this shop enough and I will continue to shop here.
It's the only place in Blanchardstown that does live food for my little lizard Izzy

I bought a few corals at a good price and good quality. I wish I'd known they had a marine aquarium, because the fish in the store are larger and in better condition than those I bought from the competition.

Visited yesterday for the first time. I thought I had been in every tropical fish store in Ireland until I stumbled across this petstop and am I glad i did! They have the highest quality fish/ tanks I have seen in a commercial store in this country. Huge props to the staff looking after them. They deserve every penny they earn and some. All fish were happy and healthy, tanks and plants were as clean as. If the fish staff are reading this, pat yourselves on the back and keep up the great work. I have seen other petstops in horrendous conditions so this makes me happy and definitely deserves a 5 star review. Petstop regional managers: please take the time to acknowledge what a great job they are doing in this store! As a hobbiest fish breeder I must say well done!
Staff have excellent knowledge of the fish!
Customer service 5 stars
Always helpful staff, good variety and price point isn’t too bad.
Great staff, love the fish section. Been going here for my fish needs for over 6 years now.
Premium grade meat , very professional too! All sorts of meat to choose from, be it fish or mammal. Kind of on the pricey side but that no problem for the rich. I personally recommend the "feline"
Always quick and courteous service...
Visited petstop Blanchardstown today,fantastic collection of healthy fish and corals,staff was very helpful too,highly recommend.
I'm driving 20km to buy from here and at 2 pm I'm being told the lunch break is until 3 pm. Are there no shifts??? Ridiculous.

Was a regular customer. Never ever shop in this shop again .Staff are clueless, don't care to help,  low motivation, poor staff training on assisting and helping with store products.  Very disappointed.
Had a lovely experience there with fish and the guy there was very helpful. My little one loves her fish and we are all really happy definitely going again highly recommended 👍👍 …
And

Generally good for pet related accessories and dry goods. I spend more time in the aquarium area which is not great and seems somewhat neglected (not the animals themselves, but the area in general). The aquarium department is dark, damp and sparsely stocked.
A go to pet store for us,
